notes.title: Sale time
notes.content:
Pumpkin farmer will be going on sale to help sponsor development of Before The Kingdom Falls.

Before The Kingdom Falls is in development without funding and with this Sale I hope to be able to fund a few more assets to make the game even more enjoyable.

notes.title: Pumpkin Farmer is what????
notes.content:
[h1]Pumpkin Farmer going mobile!![/h1]

Hi Farmers. Thank you for all the support and love for the game. Pumpkin farmer will soon be available for the google play store. A big thank you goes to everyone supporting this project.

And an extra reveal would be a 3D action adventure version of pumpkin farmer will be in the works so I can't wait until it is done and published. The plan is to keep the original game as an option when launching with an extra option for the 3D game.

Once again I hope you all keep planting those pumpkins.

Bug fixes will be rolled out over the next few days. If any are encountered then please report them using the support email.

notes.title: Fixing the holes in the roof
notes.content:
Sorry that it took the time to get here.

-Fixed image not showing at the "good" ending.
-Removed the files that were making the game too big for the current content. (Will be returning once finished ;)

notes.title: The End Is Here.
notes.content:
So Umm... 

Here you go... 

I'll optimize the space issue when I figure it out. Otherwise the end is here for all the pumpkins that follow the game. Happy Halloween. 


The journey has been long and difficult. But maybe we can take the last step together..

notes.title: DLC's away
notes.content: If you still have the DLCs selected then it may cause an issue. You can right click in your steam library on Pumpkin farmer and go down to DLCs and uncheck the DLC's boxes and it should work. If not then please send a bug report and we can work on the issues together.

notes.title: These Pumkins are getting smarter
notes.content:
Hi Everyone

Hope everyone is doing well. I want to announce that Pumpkin Farmers story has finished being written. I will be working on the ending and touching up on some of the story and events throughout  the rest of the year and hopefully it will be done before Halloween.

You will notice that the DLCs for pumpkin farmer 2 and 3 are no longer available. This is because they will no longer be separate of the game. The DLCs will now only be for non linear story shorts which I'll still be working on.

It has been wild with PF starting out as a cute little game to make people smile to a full blown life story of Pampoen. For those of you who have not played the game yet then I hope that you enjoy the stories and motivations behind each part. For those of you whom have already played it then I hope they connected to you in some way.

The latest update will be uploaded tomorrow.

Thank you for taking the time to read this.
I hope you have a good day today.

notes.title: Changing of the Pumpkins
notes.content:
The game has changed and hopefully it has changed for the better.

The original game was cute and made everyone smile and I hope that it still does it job however now it is in a state where I will be able to cater for those who want a nice simple game to grind hours away and hopefully not get bored.

The main game will not be changed anymore however the DLCs will add extra game play just by adding them. The save function will be available so when the DLCs get released then you will not have to restart the game you can continue straight into them.

Please note that the current DLCs are outdated. I will attempt to remove them however you may have to manually uncheck them in your settings. I will also be changing the visuals for the main store page.


Changes to some textures. The pumpkins look more pumpkiny.
Added the DLCs to the main game for more of a story arch and better flow.
Added new music and changed some dialog.
